name: AI Playwright
description: A Playwright headless-browser AI Agent tool that opens a page of this site in Chromium and returns a screenshot, title, visible text and console errors.

suggests.ext-node: Node.js 18+ with Playwright (npm install playwright && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium) is required on the server for the browser tool to run.

project_description:
AI Playwright gives Drupal AI Agents eyes on a rendered page. It opens a page of this site in a real headless browser (Playwright / Chromium, run as a bundled Node script) and hands the agent a full-page screenshot (saved as a managed file whose id can be passed to describe_image), the page title, the visible text, and any console errors - so the Drupal Canvas AI assistant can look at what it builds and verify or refine it instead of building blind. It works much like the Playwright MCP, but from inside Drupal as an AI Agent function-call tool.

What it provides: one AI Agent tool, Browser preview (Playwright) (ai_playwright:browser_preview), backed by a PlaywrightRunner service and a bundled scripts/browser-capture.mjs Node script; plus a settings page for the internal base URL the browser uses to reach the site, the Node binary, the capture timeout, the screenshot stream wrapper, and whether off-site URLs are allowed. By default the tool only ever opens paths on this site (resolved against the internal base URL); an administrator can opt into absolute off-site http(s) URLs. The runner passes every argument to Node as an argv array (never an interpolated shell string) via Symfony Process, and the tool is gated on the restricted "use ai playwright" permission.

When the browser opens an authenticated capture, the runner mints a one-time auto-login link for the acting user so the browser sees the page as that user would. Requirements: Drupal ^11.2, AI (drupal/ai) and AI Agents, Drupal core file, and on the server Node.js 18+ with Playwright and Chromium. It is the browser-eyes companion to AI Figma and AI Penpot.
